_doc: Cypht user-config — fully declarative inventory consumed by sidecar.sh → apply.php at container start. See cypht-api/README.md for schema.

primary_user._doc: Master user account — created via Cypht's own scripts/create_account.php. Password serves dual purpose: (1) login auth (hm_user.hash), (2) encryption key for hm_user_settings.settings (lib/config.php::save). It's INDEPENDENT from ME_PASSWORD (which is Maddy IMAP's password used by CardDAV/Radicale + future Maddy backends). When this env value changes, sidecar.sh detects mismatch (Hm_Auth_DB::check_credentials returns false) and rotates the hash + re-seeds.

accounts._doc: Mail accounts (IMAP / SMTP / JMAP). Source-of-truth file is shared with aa-sui_snappymail to avoid duplication. Path is relative to the cypht-api/ directory inside the container (/tmp/cypht-config/cypht-api/).

carddav._doc: CardDAV providers. Each named source becomes a key in carddav_contacts_auth_setting (modules/carddav_contacts/modules.php:28). server_template tokens: {user_url_encoded} = rawurlencode(primary_user.email).

feeds._doc: RSS feeds. Source = JSON file containing a topics list at $.topics. Path is relative to cypht-api/ (../ntfy-topics.json is a build-time copy of I_cloud-data/ntfy-api/src/topics.json — canonical SoT). url_template tokens: {topic} = rawurlencode(topic).

settings._doc: Per-user UI preferences. Each key must end in _setting per Cypht convention. Verified against modules/themes/modules.php (theme_setting), modules/sievefilters/modules.php, modules/smtp/modules.php, modules/contacts/modules.php on cypht-org/cypht.
